name: EcoTag
tagline: Phone laser tag with QR tags that also rewards players for scanning and binning real litter.

awards: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Enactus Challenge

problem: Laser tag is fun but needs equipment, and gatherings leave litter behind.
solution: Players scan QR tags on each other to score; scanning litter classifies it, estimates the CO2 saved and gives bonus points for correct disposal.
demo_moment: Team-described: tag a player, then scan a bottle and bin it for points.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Enactus Challenge” among 217 submissions.
Makes cleanup part of the game.

lessons: Attach a chore to a game people already want to play.
